title: Quartic-to-closure coefficient bridge

bridge_reading.linear_reading: 4-phi^2 = 3+phi = three Szilassi opposite pairs plus a golden tail
bridge_reading.square_reading: (4-phi^2)^2 = 13+phi^5 = Otto half-turn core plus fifth-order golden tail
bridge_reading.closure_reading: 3 opposite pairs x 2 sides x 2 orientations = 12 closure ticks; doubled gives 24 guard bins; 12*(13+1)=168 active bins

decision: Strong arithmetic bridge but still a numerical/structural resonance until equations 49/50/64/65/66 are transcribed and audited.
